digest.component_or_area: bug close transition & ticket state reducer
propositions: Bug close --reason parameter is validated but never persisted to reduced state; must replace with bounded --class enum that is folded into state and queryable via rebar show

Enum vocabulary (regression, plan_defect, env_integration, flaky, preexisting, not_a_bug, duplicate, escalated, undetermined) must be validated at two guard sites (txn.transition_core and transition_close._completion_precheck) and persisted to status_data

process_status reducer must explicitly fold close_class into reduced state via _fold_close_class helper on *->closed edges in both fork-winner and normal-update branches, mirroring _fold_claimed_session pattern
Omitting --class on bug close must exit nonzero with stderr naming at least one allowed enum value; invalid enum values must be rejected; undetermined escape value must be accepted
